hints: The push points down into the floor as well as sideways. Write the limiting condition with the larger N.
worded:
1. The force pushes the block sideways with F cos 60° and down into the floor with F sin 60°, so N = mg + F sin 60°.

2. At the critical value, F cos 60° = μ(mg + F sin 60°).

3. With μ = 1/(3√3): μ sin 60° = 1/6, so F(½ − 1/6) = μmg = (1/(3√3)) × 10√3 = 10/3.

4. F/3 = 10/3, so F = 10 N, and 3x = 10 gives x ≈ 3.33.

5. Note: if μ were as large as cot 60° = 1/√3, no push at 60° could ever move it (self-locking).
mistakes: A push downward at an angle increases N; do not use N = mg.
